command.description: Migrate legacy WebIDE Fiori project to modern Fiori tools format. In BAS, a destination is required. Outside BAS, hostname and client are required; destination is optional.

options.destination: SAP System destination name (required in BAS)
options.hostname: Backend hostname (required outside BAS unless resolved from a saved system)
options.client: SAP Client (required outside BAS unless resolved from destination or saved system)
options.ui5Version: UI5 version (defaults to source project version)
options.force: Force migration even if project is already a Fiori tools project
options.skipInstall: Skip the `npm install` step after migration

validation.destinationInvalid: Destination name must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores
validation.clientInvalid: SAP client must be a 3-digit number (e.g., 100)
validation.ui5VersionInvalid: UI5 version must follow semantic versioning format (e.g., 1.120.0)
